claims: The Federal Reserve maintained the benchmark federal funds rate at a range of 3.5% to 3.75% on March 18, 2026.
The Federal Reserve's maintenance of the benchmark federal funds rate on March 18, 2026 marked the second consecutive meeting without a change.
The FOMC voted 11-1 to hold the target range steady.
The next Federal Reserve meeting and policy announcement is scheduled for April 29-30, 2026.
CBS News and CNBC say inflation remains above the 2% target
